alpha_threshold.rule: alpha >= 8; production target bounds use inclusive minima and exclusive maxima; BRL source bounds are inclusive

hash_function.name: hashIndexTo01 / forestRandom integer hash
hash_function.description: uint32 xor with imul(seed,0x9e3779b1), avalanche multipliers 0x21f0aaad and 0x735a2d97, divided by 2^32

excluded_source_yaw.reason: Measured backlit/desaturated outliers; excluded without recolouring.

composition.placement: Four seeded, fine-grain layers follow a tapered broadleaf envelope: varied apexes, an overlapping middle-upper crown, and a narrower foliage-only base. Deterministic lateral jitter eliminates vertical slab sides while the denser, smaller crown samples close inter-crown holes.

tree_atlas.coverage_constraint_note: Exact bounds make full-cell coverage >=0.45 impossible for BL yaws whose target rectangle itself occupies <45% of the cell. Exact bounds take precedence; tight-box occupancy is reported separately and asserted >=0.45.

bottom_leaf_closure.method: A column is closed when alpha >= 8 occurs within the bottom 15% of the target tight box.

cells.tight_box_occupancy_tolerance_note: The visual target is <= 0.70. The asserted ceiling is <= 0.72 to allow a documented 0.02 raster/affine-fit tolerance and avoid a hair-trigger failure from sub-pixel sampling.

bottom_leaf_presence.method: Mean filled-width fraction across the bottom 10% of tight-box rows is at least 0.35.

composition.placement: Nine closely overlapping depth-ordered rows from skyline to ground keep the original 56-63 total count while reducing vertical seams. Smaller rear crowns and larger near crowns overlap in seeded horizontal slots; the final row closes the bottom and stronger skyline jitter preserves an undulating top.

top_silhouette_vs_r3.trade_note: Connectivity-safe skyline jitter is intentionally bounded so the top row overlaps the canopy spine; this is a documented R3-stdev trade.

affine_fit.method: Bilinear independent-axis scale/translate from composite threshold-tight bounds to production bounds, followed by four real threshold-visible edge witnesses and exact assertion.
affine_fit.alpha_compositing: Straight-alpha baked sources sampled and accumulated in premultiplied source-over space; unpremultiplied to straight RGBA8 output.

alpha_mask_connectivity.method: 8-connected alpha >= 8 mask; largest component / total filled pixels >= 0.95 for every replacement cell.
